All FAQs

What encryption standard does CompanyCam use to protect user data?

CompanyCam encrypts data in transit, TLS 1.2 or newer, and at rest, AES-256 or stronger.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=ptyq1aoeekck1zwb3vjtq0

Where are CompanyCam's servers located?

CompanyCam stores customer information with Amazon Web Services (AWS) within the United States of America. CompanyCam's primary cloud infrastructure is located in AWS us-east-1, and backups are located in us-west-2.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=qjf789rjppw0lxg2estf8e

What data does CompanyCam collect?

Please refer to CompanyCam's Privacy Policy (https://companycam.com/privacy-policy), which details what data we collects and what we do with it.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=rg3uewupa9k20fcobup9p

Where can I see current and historical CompanyCam uptime?

Current and historical uptime for CompanyCam systems can be found at https://status.companycam.com/.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=pee56oqmy0ha5i0dyb45rf

Does CompanyCam offer AI functionality within our product?

Yes. CompanyCam provides AI-powered features that can enhance documentation and streamline workflows. Use of these features are completely optional—customers can choose whether to use them or not. All core functionality of CompanyCam is fully available without AI, ensuring you remain in control while still having the option to benefit from added efficiencies.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=g3hdts2kk2h4u9a19x72kr

How does CompanyCam review its third-party vendors?

CompanyCam carefully evaluates each vendor to ensure they meet our security and compliance standards. This process includes reviewing relevant certifications (such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001) or requiring the completion of a security assessment questionnaire. Our most critical vendors are re-evaluated annually to confirm they continue to uphold these standards.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=blpt912hg2aobpaou7pdg

Does CompanyCam conduct penetration tests?

Yes. CompanyCam engages a qualified third-party security firm to perform an annual penetration test of the product. These tests validate our security controls and help us continuously improve. A high-level summary of the most recent assessment is available in this Trust Center.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=70cfba432vcqu7flb8byf

What compliance frameworks is CompanyCam compliant with?

CompanyCam maintains compliance with industry-recognized frameworks to demonstrate our commitment to security and privacy. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and comply with applicable data protection laws such as GDPR and CCPA/CPRA. These frameworks help ensure we meet high standards of security, availability, and confidentiality for our customers.

https://trust.companycam.com/faq?s=fjmn8v2d4r16341w4cs52g
